channels.name: SCK
channels.purpose: Continuous Serial Clock; one rising edge per data bit.
channels.active_levels: VH ≥ 2.0 V, VL ≤ 0.8 V; both edges meaningful (transmitter may use either; receiver uses leading)

channels.name: WS
channels.purpose: Word Select; 0 = channel 1 (left), 1 = channel 2 (right). Changes one SCK period BEFORE the MSB of the next word.

channels.name: SD
channels.purpose: Serial Data; MSB-first two's-complement audio samples for both channels time-multiplexed.

ordering_rules.channel_order_within_frame: Left (WS=0) then right (WS=1), alternating; each WS edge starts a new word.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Controller drives SCK + WS continuously. Transmitter drives SD synchronized to SCK; receiver latches SD on leading edge of SCK + WS. WS edge always precedes MSB by exactly one SCK period.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Each SD bit is sampled on a leading SCK edge; WS is sampled on the SAME leading edge to identify the channel.

handshake_pairs.name: SCK_DRIVE
handshake_pairs.rule: Continuous bit clock; one edge per SD bit.

handshake_pairs.name: WS_BOUNDARY
handshake_pairs.rule: WS transition signals channel boundary; MSB of next channel word follows on the next SCK period.

handshake_pairs.name: SD_LATCH
handshake_pairs.rule: Transmitter holds SD valid through leading edge of SCK; receiver latches on leading edge.
